releaseNotes: Built-in PDF Studio (Find & Replace headers/text, click-to-edit, whiteout & image overlay), Word DOCX Studio (split-run header/body/table Find & Replace, image resize & Microsoft Word/LibreOffice PDF preview), Image Print Canvas (A4/4x6 drag, resize, rotate, ID/Passport presets), and Merge & Print All (combine edited/original PDFs, Docs & Images into 1 single print command).
